name: Namecheap-DDNS
description: This simple container will update a namecheap dynamic dns domain. You must set an 'A + Dynamic DNS Record' for the host and enable Dynamic DNS in the manage page for your domain. For more info see: https://www.namecheap.com/support/knowledgebase/article.aspx/29/11/how-do-i-use-a-browser-to-dynamically-update-the-hosts-ip/

variables.name: HOST
variables.description: This is the host to be updated. e.g. 'www.'

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.description: This is the domain to be updated. e.g. yourdomain.tld

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.description: Your Dynamic DNS password. NOT your namecheap password.
